top_choice_rationale: P001 is a continuous, mature discovery arc from GLP-1 physiology (Holst) through the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov) and proglucagon-peptide and receptor biology with the therapeutic concept (Drucker) to independently replicated outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal disease. The three-person allocation and the physiology-anchored citation fit the achievement; the contested active-peptide priority is a credit question, not a doubt about the work's merit, so an award is preferable to none.
